32.steps:
1. On the User->Settings page, click on the "Configure SSO..." button. The SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration opens.
  2. In the RADIUS Accounting tab of the SonicWALL SSO Agent Authentication Configuration window, click Accounting Clients tab, then click the "Add..." button. View/Edit pane gets displayed in the Settings tab.

  6. Factory default firewall or modify radius accounting related settings.
  7. Import preference.

1 Export and import is validated.
  2 Configuration keeps intact.
